subject.title: perf(gateway): stop per-row store and registry rediscovery in sessions.list

question: Should `listOpenClawRegisteredAgentDatabases` treat external registry changes as restart-visible only, with invalidation limited to this module’s own writes?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes freshness semantics for persistent registry metadata; repository policy permits process-stable metadata when lifecycle-owned, but the durable external-writer contract needs maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Confirm restart-scoped registry freshness
options.body: Accept the process-stable memo because registry writers are lifecycle-owned and externally changed metadata is intentionally recognized after restart.

options.title: Require broader invalidation
options.body: Keep the performance work but add an explicit owner reload or invalidation mechanism for any supported external registry writer.

recommendation.title: Confirm restart-scoped registry freshness
recommendation.body: Accept the process-stable memo because registry writers are lifecycle-owned and externally changed metadata is intentionally recognized after restart.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor is the available recent owner signal for the affected gateway and registry optimization path.
